Name: Portable Cassette Player
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds 24 new audio cassettes that can be used with an portable cassette player to play music on the go!

How to use:
[spoiler]
Buy the cassette player and any audio cassette.

Hold the cassette in menu and right-click on the player to start.
[/spoiler]

Shops:
[spoiler]
Saloon:
Portable Cassette Player - 1000G

Spring Cassettes - 350G each.
Condition: Season is Spring.

Summer Cassettes - 350G each.
Condition: Season is Summer.

Fall Cassettes - 350G each.
Condition: Season is Fall.

Winter Cassettes - 350G each.
Condition: Season is Winter.

Desert Festival:
Bachelor and Bachelorette Themes - 100 Calico Eggs each. 
[/spoiler]

I was going to do a VHS one, but then I gave up and did this one instead, maybe when I learn more C#.
